query_text: what is the funnest terraria class

content.text:
The **funnest Terraria class** is usually **Summoner**, especially in mid-to-late game.

Why Summoner is so fun:
- You get an army of minions fighting for you.
- Whips make combat more active instead of just standing back.
- It feels very different from the other classes.
- You can focus on dodging while your summons deal damage.
- Late-game summons like **Terraprisma**, **Stardust Dragon**, and **Stardust Cell** are super satisfying.

That said, it depends on your playstyle:

| Class | Why it’s fun |
|---|---|
| **Melee** | Tanky, simple, lots of flashy weapons, great for beginners |
| **Ranger** | Reliable, tons of guns/bows, good boss DPS |
| **Mage** | Most variety, crazy weapons, high damage but fragile |
| **Summoner** | Unique, minion army, active dodging, whips |
| **Mixed** | Lets you use whatever cool weapon you find |

My personal pick: **Summoner** for fun, **Mage** for variety, and **Melee** if you want the easiest chill playthrough.

If you’re new, I’d say go **Melee first**, then try **Summoner** once you know the bosses.
